t: You're outside the building on Albany Street that was known as St George's Cathedral. It was built to designs by James Pennethorne, an architect and planner closely associated with buildings and parks in central London, and consecrated in 1837 as an Anglican church called Christ Church. From 1989 to 2023 it served as an Antiochian Orthodox cathedral, and that is when it took the name of Saint George, the early Christian martyr and soldier, venerated especially as a military saint. It is now a former church building.
